about: Every current doc route with its docs-tree placement. The CLI's own docs are placed (spec:AST-046, phase 1): the namespace rows and the command, function, and enum rows say where the tree puts them, and (d) checks it. Every other row is still a PROPOSED placement that moves nothing. doc-routes.test.mjs fails when a current route has no row, a row names a route that no longer exists, or a row breaks the placement rules below.

Rows: one per built-in topic (`astryx docs <topic>`) and per section key (`astryx docs <topic> <key>`); typed descriptors take one row per provider and kind, with `count` and the ids in doc-routes.ids.json under the row id. Placeholders <id> expand per id. Per-item rows would repeat one decision per group hundreds of times (704 templates alone).

placement: keep-flat (the route stays where it is), namespace:<path> (the doc becomes <path> in the graph), or generated:<provider>/<kind> (the unorganized bucket for typed descriptors that author no placement). Anything but keep-flat carries a one-line evidence note, and a namespace must be decided `create` under namespaces.
aliasNeeded: true when the proposal leaves the old CLI route or docsite URL without its content unless an alias keeps it resolving. Sections move with their topic.

oldDocsiteUrl: the public docsite URL (paths on astryx.atmeta.com). Topic and section URLs are checked; section anchors are the docsite outline ids (slugged titles). docsiteExceptions on descriptor rows were measured on 2026-09-24 from a canary data build of apps/docsite and are not rechecked by the test; production documents the latest published core, so a newer component has no page until release.

namespaces.name: cli
namespaces.evidence: cli/integrations documents the CLI's integration surface (see its row), and the NamespaceDoc contract's own example is a 'cli' namespace for commands, APIs and integration authoring.
namespaces.note: `astryx docs cli` reads the docs tree (spec:AST-046): its guides and the commands and api namespaces, one level at a time. /docs/cli is still the @astryxdesign/cli package page on the docsite; the namespace page must take that URL before the docsite publishes it. Considered and left out: authoring, whose section docs declare namespace 'authoring', a sibling of 'cli' in the SchemaDoc contract.

namespaces.name: unorganized
namespaces.evidence: Every flat topic had no home in the tree: no parent, no breadcrumb, and Up went back to the topic list.
namespaces.note: The docs tree generates it (spec:AST-046 FR12). Each topic keeps its own name, so no route changes; the proposed placements in the rows below move topics out of it into real sections.

namespaces.name: theme

namespaces.name: migration
